quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #6
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 35

questions.question: For drivers 21 or older, it is illegal to drive with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of:
questions.explanation: Drivers 21 or older cannot legally drive with a BAC of 0.08 percent or higher. Driving under the influence is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: ____ limit your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory.

options.text: Only a blood alcohol level greater than the legal limit can
Even the smallest amount of alcohol can
Only a blood alcohol level greater than 0.05 percent can

questions.correctAnswerText: Even the smallest amount of alcohol can
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol hurts your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory. Your driving skills suffer immediately. No one can drink and drive safely.

questions.question: When you see or hear an emergency vehicle coming, you should:

options.text: Stop immediately and let the vehicle pass.
Drive as far toward the right side of the road as is safe and stop.
Proceed slowly and permit the vehicle to pass.
Keep moving slowly, staying to the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive as far toward the right side of the road as is safe and stop.
questions.explanation: You must yield to an emergency vehicle using its lights or siren. Move to the right side of the road as far as safely possible and stop. Do not stop within an intersection.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: When driving near heavy trucks, you must allow for:

options.text: The increased stopping distance required by large vehicles.
The decreased stopping distance required by large vehicles.
The decreased noise of larger vehicles.
The increased speed of larger vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: The increased stopping distance required by large vehicles.
questions.explanation: Heavy trucks need more distance to stop than smaller vehicles. Stay in places where the truck driver can see you. Do not let the truck block your view of the road ahead.

questions.question: A solid yellow line on your side of the centerline means:
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line next to your lane means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: When two vehicles reach an intersection at the same time with no signs or signals, which has the right-of-way?

options.text: The car approaching from the right has the right-of-way.
The car approaching from the left has the right-of-way.
The car in which the driver sounds his horn first has the right-of-way.
The car that is traveling the fastest has the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car approaching from the right has the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: At an intersection with no traffic control device, you must yield to a vehicle coming from your right.

questions.question: If you miss your exit on the interstate, you should:

options.text: Quickly cut across traffic to make your turn.
Make a U-turn to go back to the exit.
Continue driving and use the next exit.
Put your vehicle in reverse to go back to the exit.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue driving and use the next exit.
questions.explanation: Do not make sudden turns to catch your exit. Continue to the next exit instead.

questions.question: When crossing railroad tracks with no signals or gates, you should:

options.text: You have the right-of-way and do not need to check for trains.
You may pass slower drivers while crossing the track.
You need to make sure there is space for your vehicle to get all the way across the tracks without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: You need to make sure there is space for your vehicle to get all the way across the tracks without stopping.
questions.explanation: Before crossing railroad tracks, check that you have enough room to cross completely without stopping. Never pass another vehicle at a railroad crossing. Always look for trains before crossing.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.question: Many crashes happen because:

options.text: Drivers are going too fast for the road conditions.
Drivers check their mirrors and blind spots regularly.
Drivers keep a four-second distance behind other cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers are going too fast for the road conditions.
questions.explanation: Many crashes happen because drivers go too fast for the conditions. Always drive at the legal speed limit and slow down when conditions are poor.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a steep downhill section is coming up.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in that direction.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you that the area ahead has low clearance.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is coming from both directions ahead.

questions.question: When is street racing allowed?
questions.explanation: Street racing is illegal and dangerous. It causes serious injuries and deaths. Street racers endanger other drivers because they race on public roads at very high speeds. At these speeds, drivers cannot react to hazards, which causes crashes.

questions.question: What color are signs that show the distance to the next highway exit?
questions.explanation: Signs that show directions and destinations are green with white letters or symbols.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Only pennant-shaped warning signs are used to show a no passing zone.

questions.question: Large vehicles have:

options.text: The same blind spots as smaller vehicles.

questions.explanation: The bigger the vehicle, the bigger the blind spots. Large trucks and SUVs have areas near the back that you cannot see in the side or rearview mirrors.

questions.question: To avoid being blinded by oncoming headlights at night, look:

options.text: At the center of the road
To the right edge of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: To the right edge of the road.
questions.explanation: If an oncoming driver does not dim their lights, keep your eyes on the right side of the road ahead. Do not look directly at the headlights because the glare can blind you for several seconds.

questions.question: Leaving space between your vehicle and others is important because it:

options.text: Gives you time to react to unexpected situations.
Keeps traffic flowing at a safe pace.

questions.correctAnswerText: Gives you time to react to unexpected situations.
questions.explanation: Leaving plenty of space between you and other vehicles ensures you have enough time to react if other drivers make mistakes.

questions.question: When driving on icy or snowy roads, which technique helps avoid crashes?

options.text: Add extra weight to improve traction.
Get off highways as quickly as possible.
Slow down and stay farther behind other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and stay farther behind other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Reduce your speed on snow or ice. Slowing down and increasing your distance from other vehicles are the best ways to avoid crashes in winter conditions.

questions.question: When driving in traffic, the safest approach is to:

options.text: Change your speed often to stay alert.
Drive at the same speed as other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive at the same speed as other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers go faster or slower than the traffic around them. Drive with the flow of traffic, but do not exceed the speed limit.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that construction is ahead and you should slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: Your vehicle hits a parked car and the owner is not there. You:

options.text: Have done as much as you can.
Must leave a note with your name, address, and what happened.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must leave a note with your name, address, and what happened.
questions.explanation: Stop and try to find the owner. If you cannot find them, leave a written note that includes your name, address, and details about the accident.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming and you should prepare to stop completely.

questions.question: You cannot pass other vehicles within ____ of a bridge, viaduct, or tunnel.
questions.explanation: Do not pass other vehicles within 100 feet of a bridge, viaduct, tunnel, railroad crossing, or intersection. Only pass where it is legal and safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads. You must stay on the right side.

questions.question: If you need to stop quickly and your vehicle does not have an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS), what should you do?
questions.explanation: Pumping the brakes is the best way to stop in an emergency. Your car will stop quickly and you can still steer.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs tell drivers to stop and give the right-of-way at an intersection. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic only moves in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What should you do when another car is tailgating you?

options.text: Move to the right lane if one is open.
If no right lane is open, wait for clear road ahead and slowly reduce your speed to let the tailgater pass.

questions.explanation: If being tailgated, move right if a lane is open. If not, wait for clear road and slowly reduce speed to let them pass. Never brake suddenly, as this increases the risk of being hit from behind.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are coming to:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does a posted speed limit sign show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. Safe driving may require you to go slower than the limit. When conditions are poor, slow down.

questions.question: Where is passing prohibited?
questions.explanation: You cannot pass another vehicle on hills, curves, at intersections, or at railroad crossings. These areas are unsafe for passing.
